verdict.rationale: Anthropic provides an explicit SKILL.md template (with placeholder frontmatter fields like name/description) and a formal spec defining required frontmatter fields, plus a dedicated 'skill-creator' skill whose purpose is to help authors create and iteratively improve new skills without needing to reverse-engineer existing ones; a runtime probe confirms the template/spec-conformant SKILL.md installs and reads back cleanly via third-party tooling. Missing for 10: a first-party step-by-step 'getting started authoring a skill' tutorial narrative and independent developer testimony specifically praising ease of authoring from the template (community commentary instead focuses on invocation reliability, not authoring difficulty).
